briefing: Field Report from Agent Polaris: The Minnesota fraud scandal continues to unfold with multiple investigations and charges. Congresswoman Ilhan Omar is under investigation for alleged ties to the scandal. AECOM is also under investigation for securities law violations. The scandal involves a large-scale pandemic relief fraud scheme with alleged ties to Somalia. Multiple entities and individuals are being investigated, and prosecutors are seeking a 50-year sentence for the founder of Feeding Our Future. The Minnesota legislature has made fighting fraud a priority, and law enforcement agencies are actively working to uncover and prosecute cases.
